header.name: mcs51_thermos safety: NTC short -> FAULT latches heater off -> probe recovers -> auto OFF

steps.description: Cold water present before first control tick: 8-bit code ~240 -> 25 C (valueNorm = code/4095, low-byte rail convention)
Telemetry: HEAT with heater on before fault
NTC probe shorts: rail 0 -> 8-bit code 0 <= NTC_SHORT_CODE(8) => sensor-short fault
Fault forces heater relay off immediately (safe state re-derived every control tick)

Telemetry frame at ~3 s: FAULT state (S=3), heater forced off (H=0), fault code 2 = NTC short (short injected 2.0 s, latched by the ~2.1 s control tick). Idle-gap framing (ADR-0065) targets the post-fault frame directly. Frame field order is S,H,F.
Probe recovered: code back to ~240 (valid range)

Telemetry frame after probe recovery (recovered 4.5 s, auto-OFF by the ~4.6 s tick): S=0, H=0, F=0, heater stays off with no auto-restart. Idle-gap framing targets the post-recovery frame directly. Frame field order is S,H,F.
Heater remains off after fault recovery (no auto-restart)
